svg.title: lect13d p1 gametes missing
svg.desc: Original ODP product groups: adjacent-1 left, adjacent-2 middle, alternate right; each of four product pairs and every source image occurrence remains separate. Eight original source rejection crosses remain, one for each adjacent-1 or adjacent-2 product.
